rubricName: Security — OWASP Top 10:2025 — conduit-helix-test Next.js Migration

evalCriteria.prompt: Review every Route Handler or Service in the diff that reads or mutates a resource owned by a specific user (an article, a comment, a profile update). Score 0 if any changed code path allows updating/deleting an Article or Comment, or updating a User's own profile, without verifying the authenticated session user is the resource's owner (or otherwise authorized). Cite the file and line.

Review every changed auth-related file (src/lib/auth.js, src/middleware.js, the login/register Route Handlers). Score 0 if: the JWT/session cookie is not set with httpOnly (and secure in a production-conditional way); password is stored or compared without bcrypt; a password-reset or session mechanism has no expiry; or the tightened validation rules (email format, 8-char minimum password, username format+uniqueness per functional-design.md) are absent from the register flow. Cite the file and line.

Check every changed Service/Route Handler path where user-supplied input (query params, request body, route params) reaches a Sequelize query. Score 0 if any changed path uses a raw/literal SQL string interpolating user input (e.g. sequelize.query with string concatenation) instead of Sequelize's parameterized query builder methods. Cite the file and line.

Review every changed file handling the JWT secret, password hashing, or cookie configuration. Score 0 if: a JWT secret or DB credential is hardcoded rather than read from an environment variable; the JWT signing algorithm is 'none' or a weak/deprecated algorithm; or bcrypt is replaced with a weaker hash (e.g. plain SHA/MD5) anywhere in the diff. Cite the file and line.

Review changed configuration (Next.js config, cookie options, CORS setup if any). Score 0 if a changed file sets a cookie without httpOnly/sameSite consideration, enables verbose error responses that leak stack traces to the client in a non-development mode check, or introduces an overly permissive CORS configuration where none existed before. Cite the file and line.

Review changed business logic in Services for missing threat-model controls specific to this system: self-follow prevention (functional-design.md), idempotent favorite/follow toggles, and comment-delete authorization restricted to the comment's own author. Score 0 if a changed Service implementing one of these omits the corresponding check. Cite the file and line.

Review every changed error-handling path. Score 0 if a changed Route Handler returns a raw error object, stack trace, or internal exception message to the client instead of mapping through the ported error hierarchy (src/lib/errors.js) into the Conduit spec's { errors: { body: [...] } } shape. Cite the file and line.
